{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the cross-tabulation again to confirm the confounding
confounding_check = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment'])
print(confounding_check)

# Compute conversion rates stratified by customer_segment to see if the difference is due to segment
stratified_rates = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()
print(stratified_rates)"}
